heading: `ds/tierPauseState`
text:
### `ds/tierPauseState` [NDBG.15.7]

Emitted by a follower tier when its pause state changes per
[NDBG.22.2.2].

```json
{
  "tier_id": "analytics_tier",
  "state": "pause_pending",
  "leader_tier_id": "sensor_tier"
}
```

`state` is `"pause_pending"` (received `ds/pauseRequested`, finishing
current pump cycle) or `"paused"` (pump cycle complete, fully paused).
